reviews.text: My senior toy cavapoo has been going to Lou’s grooming for over a year and she always comes home looking great! My pup is a bit nervous when it comes to grooming and Lou always goes above and beyond to make sure she’s comfortable. I highly recommend!

We had a fantastic experience with Laura! Sofi had her first groom here today and overall it was an amazing experience. Laura is great with dogs, and I could tell she took real care with Sofi’s groom! Will definitely be returning and would highly recommend! ”
Gracie had a great time and Lou did a fantastic job grooming her. Definitely recommend her and will be back 😃

Lou always does the best job with my boy, Arthur. He goes in a fuzzy, fluffy furball and emerges clean and polished and looking more dapper than ever. In addition to her great grooming skills, Lou puts up with Arthur—who does NOT like getting groomed—and does so with a smile and a laugh. Thanks, Lou, for the excellent service!
Alfie always has an excellent groom.

Laura is a dog whisperer! Bailey LOVES her, she is kind and patient.

Best groomer in London

Amazing dog whisperer of a woman❤️ managed to shave my Chinese crested legs and cut his feet hair which I genuinely didn’t think anyone could do, I’m so relieved, he was having so many problems with allergies. He was very dramatic but Lou stayed calm and just got the job done. Would Highly recommend!!
I'm really happy with Sally's look. Lou Really cares, and it shows, in the way dogs take to her.  I wouldn't go anywhere else.
Thanks Anne!

Lovely care, really thoughtful and kind.
Clara came back realy happy, and so did we.

First time using Lou’s grooming incredibly happy with the results our mochi looks and smells amazing definitely will be returning and highly recommend to anyone who needs a brilliant dog groomer 5 stars

Laura was absolutely brilliant with my naughty soap dodger of a Jack Russell. She did a brilliant job of tidying up a dog that will not be tidied.
I like her scruffy and I love that Laura cleaned up her beard, got rid of her loose coat and gave her a good trim whilst maintaining the integrity of her magnificent eyebrows and ear hair. And all whilst dealing with a natural anarchist / escape artist.
Laura dealt with the soap dodger (and me!) with patience and grace and I absolutely recommend her (particularly for those of a tricky temperament).
Thanks Lou 😊
We are so happy with Yoshi’s grooming. Laura was very sweet and gentle with him. He looks so smart ready for spring. Thank you Laura, see you next time.

We have been going to Lou's Grooming for years now and wouldnt ever go anywhere else! Very hard to find someone to groom my breed of dog as she is also super nervous, but Lou is great! She takes her time and truly cares about the dogs. My bella smells gorgeous! Highly recommended.

Highly recommend Laura's services as a dog groomer. I'm a 5+ years loyal customer after countless disappointments at other local groomers. Laura has developed a trusted relationship with my nervous dog, she really is magic.

Lou is amazing and caring and her love for animals shines through, my dog is always excited to go even though he doesn’t love being bathed at home as he likes it there so much, he also comes out looking and smelling beautiful 🤩 Would recommend! …
My pup had a great grooming experience at Lou’s. She looks great and was well looked after, even got some bonus Christmas treats to take away :) Would recommend!
amazing service , i would definitely recommend lou’s grooming services. she leaves my dog smelling so fresh and looking just as clean !!
My dog didn’t want to leave the salon and he came back cleaner than ever
friendly , welcoming one of the best experiences we’ve had

After a not so positive experience for her first time at another groomers we were nervous about trying somewhere new but Laura is honestly incredible, could not recommend her enough! Our Pinto gets so excited whenever she’s going for a groom and always leaves looking and smelling amazing 😊 you can tell that Laura truly loves what she does; it’s reflected in the quality of her work and the faces of happy pups leaving the salon. I’d highly recommend Lou’s Grooming to any dog owners looking for a caring and professional service.

I can’t say enough good things Lol's Grooming. Laura treated my dog with so much care and patience. She came home looking (and smelling!) amazing, and it’s clear she felt comfortable the whole time. You can tell they genuinely love what they do. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares about your dog!

Very informative and updated me 15 minutes before so I can come pick up my little Tofu.
She came back so clean, soft and cheerful ☺️ and she smelt amazing. Super happy with my experience and will be back again!
My miniature poodle had a grooming treatment today at Lou’s and she looks and smells lovely 🥰 …
The best groomer in Stokey! Lou loves dogs and her service is the best. My dog loves it.

My cockapoo, Mocha, always looks and smells amazing after every groom! Lou’s Grooming is so patient, gentle and clearly loves what she does. Not to mention Mocha absolutely loves her too 🎀. I would 100% recommend. …
Lou is kind, professional and always takes great care of our dog.

Lou’s Grooming is absolutely wonderful! She’s so kind and patient with my dog, Halo, and always makes her feel completely at ease. You can tell she truly loves and understands dogs. Every time I pick Halo up, she looks amazing and so well cared for. I’m so grateful to have found someone who takes such gentle, thoughtful care of her. Highly recommend Lou to anyone looking for a groomer who really goes above and beyond!

“Today I took my nervous dog Bruce to Lou’s groomers and she did an amazing job as always! Bruce is getting better every time we visit because Lou is loving and patient with him and he really is beginning to trust her ! He came out looking super smart 👌 Thank you Lou we wouldnt want to take Bruce anywhere else 🐶 …

So pleased with Rory’s groom and deshedding mask! He really needed it and looks much better for it. Also really appreciate the convenient booking system, communication, photos & payment system. Thank you!

Since moving to Islington 2 years ago - someone I met whilst walking my dog recommended Lou’s Grooming to me & from the minute I spoke with Lou she has been nothing but nice, helpful - even answering questions for me that isn’t part of her job role about my dog. I am the MOST comfortable I have ever been taking my dog rolo to Lou, he loves her just as much as she loves him - in the past I’ve been worried leaving my dog at other grooming companies but with Lou, I feel so comfortable leaving Rolo in her hands to have a full pamper. Rolo always comes out so clean smelling beautiful & you can see she really puts her heart and soul into grooming our babies.  I’ve moved from Islington to Loughton now, but I still will drive all the way to Lou to groom rolo, I won’t ever go to anyone else. Thank you again Lou! You the best ❤️

While our dog was being groomed, Lou messaged us saying we needed to take our dog to the vet urgently and that he needed to be shaved. This really worried us, so we took him to the vet right away. Luckily, the vet said he was fine and didn’t need to be shaved… We asked Lou about the vet bill, but she wouldn’t cover the cost. Our vet kindly took time to call her , so hopefully she doesn’t do this to other dogs.

Jessy looks absolutely beautiful after her  first  groom with Laura.
Laura was very attentive to what I wanted and made Jessy feel very relaxed and comfortable immediately.
This must be the best groom Jessy has had .
I can highly recommend Laura.
wonderful service - highly recommend
Thank you for your great work and patience with our very nervous fog Pluto!!

I can’t recommend Lou’s enough. My puppies were brought here for a full toy groom and they came out better than I could have expected. Fluffy, happy, clean and lovely. We even left with a bow around the holidays which was a nice little treat. Not too expensive and right on my doorstep too, great friendly relatable professional service. I’ll be back as a regular, thanks Lou :)
Lou was great with Rufus and he looks amazing! Helped advise us on the right style for him and even gave him some chicken as a treat. Defo recommend! Thank you so much x
Lou was fab! Lovely groom for my dog, and so kind with him. Quick to respond to messages. Highly recommend!
Laura did a great job grooming our sweet mini-poodle!
Lou is lovely and a great groomer! Super meticulous and not a hair missed - love it!
